relations.evidence: This is the revised and enlarged edition of my PhD dissertation submitted to SOAS, London University in 1996 under the supervision of Dr. Tadeusz Skorupski.

relations.subject: Masahide Mori
relations.evidence: the opportunity of studying in SOAS from 1988 as a PhD student enabled me to make substantial progress... I was able to submit my PhD dissertation to SOAS in 1996 and the degree was bestowed in 1997.
